title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.8
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.8 is now available.
Startup progress now follows real configuration, GTA detection, and per-version client verification stages.
Improved GTA launch verification: the launcher waits for a stable visible game window before confirming that the game is running.
Ctrl+R now reloads the launcher interface without returning to the startup splash or repeating verified client scans.
Streamlined the launcher by removing unused tabs and settings clutter, with compact Client & Voice Preflight controls.
Click Update Now below to automatically download and upgrade your launcher.
